title: First clarinet, lessons, marriage and children
summary: Got his clarinet at about 17 around 1919; Tio could not teach him; he married in 1923 and moved.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives
